name: Federal Interest Rates and Residential Building Permits (2019-2024)
description: Monthly merged dataset combining the U.S. Effective Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) and New Private Housing Units Authorized by Building Permits (PERMIT) from January 2019 through December 2024, plus statistical analysis of their relationship for the IS 477 final project at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign.
